svg.text: Color is the family: blue reference, white authored, amber observed, green computed, purple interface. A child hangs below its parent; connectors across areas run through the gutters.

svg.text: Every derived entity (green) is written by a tool, never by hand. A snapshot reports one organization and one infrastructure shape; nothing is blended across shapes.
